description: Update the authenticated bot's nickname, avatar, or banner in one server. Provide at least one profile field. Pass null to clear a field. Changing the nickname requires Change Nickname in that server.

avatar.description: PNG, JPEG, or GIF avatar as a base64 data URI or Discord CDN URL. Pass null to clear.

banner.description: PNG, JPEG, or GIF banner as a base64 data URI or Discord CDN URL. Pass null to clear.

nickname.description: Bot nickname in this server (1-32 characters). Pass null to clear.

name: discord_update_bot_guild_profile
title: Update the Bot's Server Profile
